page.overview:
Who is Photo Finish?

Photo Finish's human counterpart appears in the My Little Pony Equestria Girls franchise. She is a student at Canterlot High School and lead singer for the band "Photo Finish and the Snapshots".

In My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Rainbow Rocks, Photo Finish appears during Better Than Ever taking pictures of Big McIntosh, the Cutie Mark Crusaders, Snips, Snails, and Trixie near the statue in front of the school. She also appears at the beginning of Battle having lunch with Thunderbass as the Dazzlings enter.

In the Rainbow Rocks animated short Perfect Day for Fun, Photo Finish appears at the Canterlot High carnival.

In My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games, Photo Finish appears at various times taking photographs. At one point in the film, she appears in her Battle of the Bands attire from Rainbow Rocks.
